goal: A website for people visiting Hampi: what to see, when to go, how to reach it, where to stay, all taken from the internet with the source under each fact. Work out yourself what has to be done and in what order; I do not want a fixed way of working, make the steps as you go.
why: founder 2026-09-30: 'Can you try out a new use case wherein someone wants to create a website from the Mac app? You can try out, but each of the adaptations doesn't do any kind of template. It creates engines on the fly. It creates a website, and data is taken from the internet.' The person wants a site and says so in their words; the department's own Adaptation is to shape the engines the words need (nothing from the website kind's template line), each engine reading the internet, and the site goes live. Run 1 on Beta 2.306.20-desktop as it is (the baseline: today the website kind's template line runs); run 2 on the build that carries the capability.

outcomes.expect: Hampi Guide in the tree, its row the chat with Root (no Root row), from the New organisation sheet
one department under Root after one Stamp, of a kind whose line is made on the fly: no engine on its record at birth

verify.check: kind not website; engines [] at birth

outcomes.expect: Adaptation reads the words and puts the line to the person as one ask naming the engines it shaped and what each does; nothing runs before the stamp

verify.check: an ask of kind line naming 2-5 engines; no run row before it is stamped

outcomes.expect: after the stamp the record's engines are the ones Adaptation named, born into the Library from the Do skeleton (not Plan, Write, Check, Publish), chained by what each writes and the next reads

verify.check: engines[] names == the ask's; each with reads/writes; the Library has a template per engine (made_by this department)

outcomes.expect: what the first engines file carries facts about Hampi with the page's URL after each; nothing invented; what could not be confirmed under 'Not sure'

verify.check: URLs after facts; a 'Not sure' line where a fact is missing

outcomes.expect: the last engine writes the Live site; the first publish waits for one Stamp (the rule: ask before anything reaches outside); after it the site is served at its address with the facts and their sources

verify.check: 200; the facts and their sources on the pages

variances.do: say: Add a page on the food to try there.
variances.expect: only the engines whose work the new words ask for run again (the fact engine finds food facts; the site engine rewrites); a new Live site version after the publish rule is met

verify.check: the run rows name which engines ran; Live site v2

variances.do: say a rule: Never quote a price without its date. Stamp it.
variances.expect: the rule is asked for as a rule and stamped it is on the record; the engines read it

variances.do: ask: Which source did you use for the opening hours?
variances.expect: an answer from what was filed, in the chat; no new run

verify.check: a turn word answer naming the source; no new version

variances.do: Stop while an engine reads the internet; Start again
variances.expect: Stopped and Started are turns; the run resumes; one version

variances.do: open Root settings, read it, come back
variances.expect: a pane naming what Root does, On, its rules and Hampi Guide's department; back lands on the chat

verify.check: the pane's rows; the chat after Back
